It can occur in CLW’s semi-ordinary Klingen family although its classical GL₂ U_p roots have valuation 1/2,1/2. The extreme unitary valuations ±1/2 describe the ordinary case; they are not the supersingular example.

tests.name: semiOrd_two_dimensional
tests.statement: After fixing a_1=a_2=0, Λ_so has two weight variables and Krull dimension three over Z_p; the finite torus character is retained separately. The unfixed weight tuple has four coordinates.

tests.name: semiOrd_not_ordinary_projector

tests.name: semiOrdKlingen_not_ordinary_family

conventions.selmer: Σ relaxes conditions away from p only. The chosen Greenberg condition at every v|p remains in force even when v∈Σ.
